column1: # Phase 2 source-word exclusion list. One word per line: word, reason.
# A crown candidate listed here cannot headline a day (it stays a
# valid, scorable find). reason is pure-inflection, degree-form,
# past-tense-dual, or register. Hand-editable: strike a line to
# re-admit a word, or add a line to exclude one.
# Derived from Wiktionary form_of tags over the pre-cull crown pool.
# register is the one hand-flagged reason: a word that is perfectly
# valid but would be odd to type into a cute-themed game. Unlike the
# derived reasons it is a judgment call, so each carries its own note
# Nothing is ever re-admitted from this list to fill a crown slot.
# Every word here violates one of the three rules by construction,
# so no re-admission can be clean: a plural has no etymology of its
# own to reveal, which is the whole reason the cull exists. When a
# crown is retired, its replacement comes from widening the source
# Future-growth caveat: if the source pool is widened (for example
# SCOWL band 35), re-run the derivation to extend this list.
# Re-run once already, after the cached-null-etymology fix made 113
# more candidates eligible. Seven came back inflected and were added:
# defeated, defended, enhanced, filtered, mistaken, modified and
# subjects. None of them is in the source pool, so nothing on the
# calendar moved; they are listed ahead of any admission so a widened
# pool cannot carry an inflection into a crown.
